title: Ing Malugud a Kaladwa Karing Propeta
intro: Ing siwala a mamaus king katuliran mag-echo ya kareng bersikulo ning Noble Quran. Iting mapalad a kaladwa mirinan yang propesiya at banal a kasulatan keng panaun nung kapilan ing patnube kailangan yang maragul kareng anak ning Israel. Ing indibidwal a ini migsalita yang diretsu kareng memalen na, inagkat nala para ganakan de ing karelang Ginu. King kapamilatan ning kapibabatan at debosyon, meging sulu la nung nu ing karelang istorya papaslag na la ring bulung ning banal a kasulatan. Malyari meng akilala ining makabaldugan a tau na ing lagyu na miparangal ya keng Quran ampo keng Gospel?
clues: Miparangal ku king pangapropeta at metung a libru banua king panaun ning pamangailangan da ring kanakung tau.
I ima ku penganak na ku keng makabaldugan a paralan, kapamilatan ning banal a utus ning Allah mu.
Migsalita ku karing memalen ku, ngana, O Anak ning Israel! Aku ing tubud ning Allah keka, a magpatutu king minunang dinatang kanaku.'
Dinatang kung maki malino tanda ibat king kekang Ginu, magdalang masayang balita tungkul king metung a propeta a ing lagyu na Ahmad.
I ima ku metung yang babaing matulid a migdedika kanaku king pamagsilbi king Allah manibat king kanakung kayanakan.
Tiru na ku ning Allah king Quran at gewa na kung mapaglunus at katungkulan kang ima ku, at e ku mayabang o e mapamintu.

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verse: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic." (61:6)
